# HR Officer

## About the Role

We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented HR Officer to join our growing People & Culture team. In this role, you will serve as a key point of contact for employees and management, supporting the full employee lifecycle from recruitment through offboarding. You will play a vital role in fostering a positive workplace culture, ensuring compliance with employment legislation, and driving initiatives that support employee engagement and organizational success.

This is an excellent opportunity for an HR professional who enjoys a hands-on, generalist role with exposure to a broad range of HR functions.

## Key Responsibilities

- Support end-to-end recruitment activities, including drafting job descriptions, coordinating with hiring managers, screening candidates, scheduling interviews, and managing offer processes
- Manage employee onboarding and induction programs to ensure a smooth and engaging experience for new hires
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records, HRIS data, and personnel files in compliance with data protection regulations
- Serve as the first point of contact for employee queries relating to HR policies, procedures, benefits, and payroll
- Support performance management cycles, including probation reviews, appraisals, and development planning
- Assist in the development, implementation, and review of HR policies and procedures in line with employment law and best practice
- Coordinate employee relations matters, including grievances, disciplinary actions, and absence management, escalating complex cases as appropriate
- Administer employee benefits, leave, and compensation processes in collaboration with payroll
- Support learning and development initiatives, including identifying training needs and coordinating training sessions
- Contribute to HR reporting, producing metrics and insights on headcount, turnover, absence, and other key indicators
- Assist with employee engagement initiatives, wellbeing programs, and internal communications
- Support offboarding processes, including exit interviews and documentation

## Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field
- 2+ years of experience in an HR generalist or HR administration role
- Working knowledge of employment law and HR best practices
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport across all levels of the organization
- High level of discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive information
- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
- Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and comfortable working with HRIS platforms
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in record-keeping and documentation
- A proactive, solutions-focused approach and a genuine interest in supporting people

## Preferred Qualifications

- CIPD Level 3 or 5 qualification (or equivalent HR certification such as SHRM-CP, PHR)
- Experience with HRIS systems such as BambooHR, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or similar
- Previous experience supporting recruitment across multiple functions
- Exposure to employee relations casework
- Familiarity with GDPR and data protection principles as they apply to HR
- Experience working in a fast-paced or scaling organization

## What We Offer

- Competitive salary and annual performance bonus
- Comprehensive health and wellbeing benefits
- Generous annual leave and flexible working arrangements
- Professional development budget and support toward HR certifications
- Collaborative, inclusive team culture with real opportunities to make an impact

*We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.*
